title: China Economic Momentum Stays Weak as Consumption Falters
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - The China Show opens
00:03:48 - Washington, Beijing clash with AI leaders over safety concerns
00:11:13 - Traders weigh AI caution against rising Treasury yields
00:16:29 - China's loan demand remains weak
00:25:47 - Breaking: China's new home prices fall 0.17% M/M
00:27:41 - China State Construction International's Zhou Zhike on HK's Northern Metropolis
00:37:07 - Hong Kong's John Lee holds briefing ahead of five-year plan
00:43:34 - Breaking: Kioxia says timing, method and market of ADR listing remain undecided
00:48:27 - CICC's Yanliang Miao on AI's impact on China's economy
01:03:04 - Kioxia says timing, method and market of ADR listing remain undecided
01:10:46 - US 10-year yield briefly tops 5%, stoking bond market fears
01:12:54 - Why an AI slowdown won't derail the Korea-Taiwan chip boom
01:21:28 - China's biotech stocks emerge as the latest AI trade
01:27:20 - GAC H-shares surge on news of FAW deal
